title: BBQ sauce
preamble:

cup weakly prepared yellow mustard - 2 heaped teaspoons mustard
1/2
cup apple cider vinegar vinegar
1/2
cup brown sugar
1
tablespoon honey
1
heaped teaspoon chopped oregano
1
heaped teaspoon chopped thyme
2
tablespoons tomato paste
1
teaspoon salt
1

1

2

1
teaspoon salt
1

1
teaspoon black pepper
1
teaspoon white pepper

Method:-
Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and simmer for 30 minutes.
Allow to cool, place in an airtight container, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours to blend the flavors.
Beware - this could be hot!!!
